scripts.check: npm run check:anti-slop && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:source-policy && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown site/src site/shared site/e2e site/playwright.config.ts site/tools site/workers/src site/workers/tests site/workers/tools workers/router/src workers/releases/src .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/check-source-policy.mjs tools/oxlint/sync-anti-slop.mjs oxlint.config.ts prettier.config.js package.json site/package.json site/workers/package.json tsconfig.json site/tsconfig.json site/workers/tsconfig.json workers/router/tsconfig.json workers/releases/tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown site/src site/shared site/e2e site/playwright.config.ts site/tools site/workers/src site/workers/tests site/workers/tools workers/router/src workers/releases/src .github/workflows/ci.yml tools/check-source-policy.mjs tools/oxlint/sync-anti-slop.mjs oxlint.config.ts prettier.config.js package.json site/package.json site/workers/package.json tsconfig.json site/tsconfig.json site/workers/tsconfig.json workers/router/tsconfig.json workers/releases/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts site/src site/shared site/e2e site/playwright.config.ts site/tools site/workers/src site/workers/tests workers/router/src workers/releases/src tools/check-source-policy.mjs
scripts.lint:site: oxlint --config oxlint.config.ts site/src site/shared site/e2e site/playwright.config.ts site/tools
scripts.lint:site:fix: oxlint --fix --config oxlint.config.ts site/src site/shared site/e2e site/playwright.config.ts site/tools
scripts.test: npm run test:site && npm run test:workers
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:tools && npm run typecheck:site && npm run typecheck:workers && npm run typecheck:router && npm run typecheck:releases
scripts.typecheck:router: wrangler types workers/router/worker-configuration.d.ts --config workers/router/wrangler.toml --check && tsc --project workers/router/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:workers: wrangler types site/workers/worker-configuration.d.ts --config site/workers/wrangler.toml --check && tsc --project site/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit
